correctness.rationale: For one size-biased draw (all users eligible), the conditional diversity multiplier is f(S,r)=1-[r/(S+r)]². The total is deterministic and the tower rule gives a positive product times D₀>0. At fixed pre-swap total S, the diversity-factor difference for b,a versus a,b is 2Sab(a−b)/[(S+a)(S+b)(S+a+b)²]; e.g. after extracting S/(S+a+b)² the difference reduces to 2ab/(S+b)−2ab/(S+a). The next total and all other factors agree. Adjacent inversion removal proves the unique minimizing boost sequence for expected H; reversing the argument proves the maximum, with ties at the extrema only for identical boost sequences. T=1 or all equal boosts have just one sequence class. This does not assert injectivity among nonextremal orders. The periodic auxiliary product has equal sums of the Gamma shifts in numerator and denominator, so the powers cancel; bounded martingale convergence justifies the expected limit. The stated M=1 value and large-M equivalent follow by telescoping and Γ(x)∼1/x. Independent exact state enumeration verifies the 2/3 and 31/45 witnesses and small nonuniform cases; it is not an all-permutations proof.
residual_risks: Does not apply to restricted recipient sets, adaptive amounts or different batch/refresh rules.
